Better-IN-Q v0.7.2
面板操作说明 / Panel Guide
=========================

中文
====

一、打开面板与基本操作
--------------------
以下是默认快捷键；如果你改过快捷键，以设置页显示的为准。

打开 / 关闭面板：手柄 LB + LT + X，或键盘 Insert。
重开任务：手柄 LT + RT + L3 + R3，或键盘 Delete。
只重置任务：手柄 LB + RB + L3 + R3，或键盘 Home。
L3 / R3 表示按下左 / 右摇杆。手柄按键名称采用 Xbox 标识。

面板内：
· 十字键 / 左摇杆 / 键盘方向键：移动选择。
· 键盘也可用 WASD（W 上、A 左、S 下、D 右），或 HJKL（H 左、J 下、K 上、L 右）。
  搜索、改名或录入快捷键时，这些字母不会用来导航。
  下文单独写 A / B / X / Y 时指手柄按键；键盘 A 用于向左，确认请用空格或回车。
· A / 空格 / 回车：确认或操作当前项。
· B / Esc：返回；在主页面返回会关闭面板。
· 向左移动到内容边缘后进入左侧栏，上下选择页面，向右返回内容。
· 鼠标左键：点击操作；鼠标滚轮：滚动列表。
· 输入框支持中文、英文和日文输入。

打开面板后，默认选中主页的「重开」，直接按 A 即可重开。
面板打开时，请在面板内完成操作；关闭后恢复游戏操作。
除需单独确认的操作外，设置和编辑内容会自动保存。

二、任务页
----------
「重开」：按当前选择的任务和重开方式重新开始。
「只重置任务」：重置并回到据点，不重新接任务，也不出发。

选择「换任务」，找到任务后确认，即可设为下次重开的任务。
搜索支持任务 ID、中文 / 英文 / 日文任务名、中文拼音及首字母、日文假名及罗马音。
例如：heilong、hl、kokuryuu。

套装指定了任务时，重开优先使用套装中的任务。
未套用指定任务的套装时，使用任务页当前显示的任务。

三、套装页
----------
一套预设可以组合：装备套装、道具套装、猫饭和任务。
选择「新建套装」并输入名称即可创建；名称留空时使用默认名。

列表操作：
· A / 空格 / 回车 / 鼠标左键：套用当前项；对已套用项再操作一次，取消套用。
· Y / 键盘 Y / 鼠标右键：直接编辑，不改变当前套用选择。
· X / 键盘 F：修改名称，最多 50 个字符，可以重名。
· L3 / 键盘 E：进入移动模式；用上下方向键、W / S 或 K / J 调整顺序，再按 L3 / 手柄 A / 键盘 E 放下，B 取消。

编辑时，分别选择装备、道具、猫饭和任务；「—」表示不更换该项。
猫饭选择「跟全局那份」时，使用猫饭页选中的预设。
「联动快捷栏」用于同时切换所选道具套装关联的快捷栏。
游戏内修改装备或道具套装名称后，面板列表会自动更新。

套用后，装备会尽快更换；读盘或重开过程中可能稍后才换上。
道具、猫饭和任务在之后重开或进入任务时按选择生效。
编辑已套用套装的装备选项，也会请求更换装备。
编辑页的「确认 / 确认并套用」会套用这套预设并返回列表。
只想修改内容、不想套用时，编辑后直接返回即可。

取消套用不会把已经穿上的装备换回去。
编辑页也可取消套用或删除该套装；删除前需要确认。

四、猫饭页
----------
选择「新建猫饭」，设置体力、耐力、攻击、防御、属性耐性和三个猫饭技能。
列表会显示预设内容，方便直接比较。

列表操作与套装页一致：
· A / 空格 / 回车 / 鼠标左键：选用，再操作一次取消。
· Y / 键盘 Y / 鼠标右键：直接编辑，不改变当前选择。
· X / 键盘 F：改名。
· L3 / 键盘 E：进入移动模式，用上下方向键、W / S 或 K / J 调整顺序；L3 / 手柄 A / 键盘 E 放下，B 取消。

选中的猫饭预设会在进入任务时使用。
未选预设或取消预设，不会清除或覆盖你在游戏里手动吃的猫饭。

如果当前套装指定了猫饭，优先使用套装中的那份。
此时猫饭页会显示提示，A 不能切换选择，但 Y / 鼠标右键仍可编辑。
只想修改内容、不想改变选择时，编辑后直接返回。

仍被套装引用的已删除猫饭会标成「（已删除）」，仍可查看和编辑；
不再有套装引用后，才会从列表消失。

五、设置页
----------
插件状态：
· 装载态：正常使用重开、套装和猫饭功能。
· 卸载态：暂停上述功能，仍可打开面板、查看和编辑；不能在列表切换套用。
  当前选择会保留，切回装载态即可继续使用，不必重启游戏。
  卸载态不等于恢复游戏原本的重置和转场速度。

其他设置：
· 语言：中文 / English / 日本語。
· 重开方式：直接重开、重置后回据点再接、只接任务不出发。
· 翼龙起始：普通地图从翼龙上开始；关闭时从营地开始。
· 缩短转场黑屏：下次启动游戏生效。
· 不透明度：调整面板背景深浅。

修改快捷键：
1. 找到「重开」「打开面板」或「只重置任务」对应的手柄格 / 键盘格。
2. 按 A 或点击该格，按住想使用的按键组合，再全部松开即可保存。
   手柄快捷键至少需要两个按键。
3. 要清除快捷键，选中该格后按 Esc；手柄格也可单按 X 清除。
   此时 Esc 只清除快捷键，不会同时返回或关闭面板。
   打开面板的快捷键至少保留一个入口。

存档位：
游戏内切换角色存档后，在这里选择对应的 1 / 2 / 3。
套装和猫饭按存档位分别保存；语言、快捷键等面板设置不随存档位切换。

从原版 IN-Q 导入：
点击「选择 config.txt…」，找到原版 IN-Q 的 config.txt 并选中。
可以用「上一级」或盘符按钮寻找文件。
注意：导入会替换当前存档位已有的套装和猫饭，请先确认是否需要保留。

清空所有套装和猫饭：
按提示完成两次确认后清空当前存档位的套装和猫饭。
此操作无法撤销，请谨慎使用。


English
-------

1. Opening the panel and basic controls
--------------------------------------
These are the default hotkeys. If you have changed them, use the bindings shown in Settings.

Open / close panel: LB + LT + X on a controller, or Insert on the keyboard.
Restart quest: LT + RT + L3 + R3, or Delete.
Reset quest only: LB + RB + L3 + R3, or Home.
L3 / R3 mean pressing the left / right stick. Controller labels use the Xbox layout.

Inside the panel:
· D-pad / left stick / arrow keys: move the selection.
· You can also use WASD (W up, A left, S down, D right), or HJKL (H left, J down, K up, L right).
  These letters do not navigate while searching, renaming or recording a hotkey.
  A / B / X / Y below refer to controller buttons unless marked as keyboard keys.
  Keyboard A moves left; use Space or Enter to confirm.
· A / Space / Enter: confirm or activate the selected item.
· B / Esc: go back; going back from a main page closes the panel.
· Move left past the content edge to enter the sidebar. Move up or down to choose a page, then right to return to its content.
· Left mouse button: click to interact. Mouse wheel: scroll lists.
· Text fields support Chinese, English and Japanese input.

The panel opens with Restart selected on the home page. Press A to restart immediately.
While the panel is open, use its controls. Close it to resume normal game controls.
Settings and edits are saved automatically, except for actions that ask for confirmation.

2. Quest page
-------------
Restart: restart using the selected quest and restart mode.
Reset quest only: reset and return to base without accepting another quest or departing.

Choose Quests, find a quest, and confirm it to use it for the next restart.
Search accepts quest IDs, Chinese / English / Japanese names, Chinese pinyin and initials, and Japanese kana and romaji.
Examples: heilong, hl, kokuryuu.

If the active loadout specifies a quest, that quest takes priority on restart.
Otherwise, the quest currently shown on the Quest page is used.

3. Loadouts page
----------------
A loadout combines an equipment loadout, an item loadout, a meal and a quest.
Choose New loadout and enter a name to create one. Leave the name empty to use a default name.

List controls:
· A / Space / Enter / left-click: apply the item. Activate the applied item again to stop applying it.
· Y / keyboard Y / right-click: edit directly without changing the active selection.
· X / keyboard F: rename, up to 50 characters. Duplicate names are allowed.
· L3 / keyboard E: enter reorder mode. Use up/down arrows, W / S or K / J to reorder, then press L3 / controller A / keyboard E to place the item, or B to cancel.

In the editor, select the equipment, items, meal and quest. “—” leaves that item unchanged.
Choose “the global meal” to use the preset selected on the Meals page.
Link shortcut bar also switches to the shortcut bar associated with the selected item loadout.
Equipment and item loadout names update automatically after you rename them in the game.

Applying a loadout changes equipment as soon as possible. During loading or a restart, the change may wait until later.
Items, meals and quests take effect on a subsequent restart or quest entry, as appropriate.
Changing the equipment option of the active loadout also requests an equipment change.
The editor's OK / apply button applies that loadout and returns to the list.
To edit without applying, make your changes and go back instead.

Stopping a loadout does not restore your previous equipment.
You can also stop applying or delete a loadout from its editor. Deletion requires confirmation.

4. Meals page
-------------
Choose New meal to set health, stamina, attack, defense, elemental resistance and three food skills.
Each list entry shows its preset details for easy comparison.

List controls are the same as on the Loadouts page:
· A / Space / Enter / left-click: select a preset; activate it again to clear the selection.
· Y / keyboard Y / right-click: edit directly without changing the selection.
· X / keyboard F: rename.
· L3 / keyboard E: enter reorder mode. Use up/down arrows, W / S or K / J to reorder; L3 / controller A / keyboard E to place, B to cancel.

The selected meal preset is used when entering a quest.
With no preset selected, manually eaten meals are not cleared or overwritten.

If the active loadout specifies a meal, that meal takes priority.
The Meals page shows a notice: A cannot change the selection, but Y / right-click still opens the editor.
To edit without changing the selection, make your changes and go back.

A deleted meal that is still used by a loadout remains visible with a “(deleted)” label and can still be edited.
It disappears from the list once no loadout uses it.

5. Settings page
----------------
Plugin state:
· Loaded: restart, loadouts and meals work normally.
· Unloaded: pauses these features while keeping the panel available for viewing and editing. Applying items from the lists is disabled.
  Your selections are kept. Switch back to Loaded to resume without restarting the game.
  Unloaded does not restore the game's original reset and transition timing.

Other settings:
· Language: 中文 / English / 日本語.
· Restart mode: restart directly, reset and return to base before accepting again, or accept without departing.
· Start with the wingdrake: begin normal maps on the wingdrake; turn it off to start at camp.
· Shorten transition fades: takes effect the next time you launch the game.
· Opacity: adjust the panel background opacity.

Changing hotkeys:
1. Find the controller or keyboard cell for Restart, Open panel or Reset only.
2. Press A or click the cell, hold the desired keys or buttons, then release all of them to save.
   Controller shortcuts require at least two buttons.
3. To clear a binding, focus its cell and press Esc. X also clears a controller cell.
   Here, Esc only clears the binding; it does not also go back or close the panel.
   At least one binding for opening the panel must remain.

Save slot:
After switching character saves in the game, select the matching slot: 1, 2 or 3.
Loadouts and meals are saved separately for each slot. Panel settings such as language and hotkeys stay the same.

Import from the original IN-Q:
Click Choose config.txt… and select config.txt from your original IN-Q folder.
Use Up or the drive buttons to find the file.
Warning: importing replaces the loadouts and meals in the current slot. Check whether you need to keep them first.

Clear all sets and meals:
Follow both confirmation prompts to clear the current slot's loadouts and meals.
This cannot be undone. Use it with care.
